india_trends.title: Succession at Reliance nearly complete, Mukesh Ambani, 69, says at shareholders meeting
india_trends.summary: While Akash, Isha and Anant lead individual business verticals, they are simultaneously working towards the holistic growth of everything under the Reliance ecosystem, Mukesh Ambani said at the RIL AGM. 'They are three bodies, one soul. Their soul is Reliance. One single indivisible Reliance.'
